title: EDIT-SYNC-01 / AST-MAP-01 / BLOCK-MAP-01 1.0.0 (design baseline)
$comment: Structure only. exec_ definitions are byte-independent structural copies of frozen EXEC-01 definitions with local references, checked for equality. Normative graph, byte ranges, reserved names, int32 values, source/AST/mapping equivalence, binding protection, session snapshot ownership and current revision gates require the accompanying 13.1 contract. No runtime support is implied.
